Since / we're trying to share what _we've_ found to be useful, we're not looking for new / skills or for pull requests that change the text of existing ones. If you've / adapted a skill and it works better for you, that's great, but please keep your / own copy. / Issues are welcome if something doesn't work as described, though we may not be / able to act on all of them. / ## Prior art / Teaching by asking questions is the / Socratic method, which is / rather older than LLMs, and there are other tutoring prompts and skills built on / the same idea.
